name: Sign In
ucs: Sign In with Password, Sign In with Google
note: On the mobile app the first field is E-mail only and the screen has no navigation bar.
elements: Switch between signing in and registering. The active tab is highlighted.
Sign in to start your journey!
Required, at most 255 characters. The server accepts the e-mail address only. A message in red appears under the field when it is empty.
Required. The text is hidden and can be shown with a button.
Checks the form, then signs in (UC Sign In with Password). A wrong e-mail or password, an inactive account and a wait after many failures each show a message and the form shakes.
Signs in with a Google account (UC Sign In with Google). A failure shows "Cannot sign in with Google. Please try again."

name: Register
note: The mobile screen also has an optional phone number field and shows a hint of at least 6 characters, while the server needs at least 8.
elements: Switch between signing in and registering.
Create an account to start your journey
Required, must be a valid e-mail address.
Required, 8 to 72 characters. The server also refuses common passwords, passwords that repeat the name or e-mail, and passwords that are too simple, and shows the reason under the field.
Required, must be the same as the password.
Creates the Learner account and sends the verification e-mail (UC Sign Up).
Registers or signs in with Google (UC Sign In with Google).

name: Verify E-mail
elements: Shown while the link in the e-mail is being checked.
Success: the address is confirmed. Failure: "The verification link is not valid or has expired", or "The verification link is incomplete. Open the correct link in the e-mail."
Goes to the Sign In screen after a result.
You can send the link again from the profile page after you sign in.
Hint under a failed result. The page itself has no field to ask for a new link.

name: Forgot Password
elements: Forgot password > Verify e-mail > Reset password
Shows which step of the recovery the user is on.
Forgot your password? Recover it fast!
Sends the request. The message "Request sent" is the same whether or not the address exists (UC Reset Forgotten Password). If sending fails: "Could not send the request. Try again."

name: Reset Password
elements: Heading. The text under it asks for the code and the new password.
Required. Filled in from the link in the e-mail, or pasted by the user.
Required, 8 to 72 characters; the same rules as when registering.
Required, must be the same as the new password.
Saves the new password and closes the other sessions. A code that is wrong, used or older than 15 minutes shows a message.

name: Welcome
ucs: Sign Up, Sign In with Password
elements: Learn step by step. Keep the rhythm every day.
Opens Onboarding for a new user.

name: Onboarding
elements: Progress bar and step counter, for example 2/6. The back arrow returns to the earlier question.
One question at a time: target band (5.5 to 7.5+), the first skill to improve, daily minutes (5 to 20), why the user studies IELTS, earlier exams, and when to remind.
Answer options; exactly one can be chosen.
Disabled until an option is chosen. After the last question the answers are saved on the phone and the app opens Register.

name: Game Catalog
ucs: View Game Catalog, Join Game Room
note: On mobile the catalogue also holds the game setup (words, time limit, lives) and asks a Guest to sign in to play.
elements: Every new word, a new challenge
Heading "LEARN THROUGH GAMES" with the words Learn, Play, Grow.

Wordly and Rocket. Each card offers solo play and, with the server, a room for up to 4 players. When no game exists: "No games yet. Please come back later." When the server cannot be reached: "Could not load the games."
Enter the room code to review and compete together.
Shown when the Learner is already in a room: "You are in a game room" with "Rejoin room".

name: Wordly Setup
elements: Heading. A box "How to play": one meaning, three planets; a wrong answer or time out costs a life.
Limited (at least 5) or unlimited: play until the lives are used up or the Learner stops.
From 3 to 6 lives. A wrong answer or a time out costs one life.
Level of the words; no choice means all levels. The topics list loads from the server.
Starts a solo game or creates a room. A Learner already in a room sees "You are in a game room" and "Rejoin room".

name: Rocket Setup
elements: Read the Vietnamese meaning and steer the rocket into the planet that carries the right English word.
Number of words in the game
Sample data in use (10 sample words, not connected to the server).
Notice shown when the app runs without the server.
Starts solo or creates a room.

name: Game Room
elements: The code with the button "Copy room code" ("Room code copied.").
Up to 4 seats. Invite friends by the code and get ready together.
Each seat shows the player, "(You)", "Room owner", "Ready", or "Free seat / Waiting for players". The owner can invite a player to leave, after confirming.
Owner only. Saving shows "Settings saved. Everyone must get ready again." "Settings unavailable" and "Reload room" appear on errors.
A player marks ready; the owner starts when everyone is ready.

name: Wordly Play
elements: Heading with the meaning of the word to guess.
Rows of letters. Colours: right place, wrong place, not in the word. A hint reveals one letter and is shown "Used 1/1 hint for this word".
On-screen keyboard that follows the colours; keys: letters, Submit, Delete.
Score, words guessed and lives left. In a room a match ranking is shown.
Reveals one letter after at least one guess (once for each word).
Asks "Exit the game?" with "Keep playing". A pending guess can be retried: "The guess is waiting for confirmation. Retry will send the same request."

name: Rocket Play
elements: Question, time left, correct and wrong counts
The Vietnamese meaning is shown; planets carry English words and the rocket flies into the right one ("Fly into the word that means …").
End of a round: correct answers, time, points earned and words practised.
Starts a new round; "Play on" continues. A knocked-out player watches: "You are out - watching".

name: Game Result
elements: Total score, Correct words, Best streak, Time
Ranking of the players with the time to the right answer.
Opens the game catalogue. "Back to home" goes home. "Back to the match" returns while the result can still be loaded.

name: Community Feed
ucs: View Community Feed, React to Post or Comment, Comment on Post
note: The mobile Community tab has the filters All, Explore and Following, a search box and the button "Write a post".
elements: Practise and improve together with the IELTSPath community
Feed, saved posts, posts of people followed, and (for staff) the queue of reports. Posts, Followers and Following lists belong to the profile.

Each post shows the author, text, pictures or video, reactions, comments and a menu to report. "Load more" loads more. Empty states: "No post found. Try other keywords", "You have no posts from people you follow", "The feed is waiting for the first story".

name: Post Detail
ucs: Comment on Post, React to Post or Comment, Report Content
note: On mobile the post opens in its own screen with a menu to edit, delete or report a comment.
elements: Author, topic, text, pictures or video, and the reactions.
Reply to the post or to another comment ("Replying to…"). Mentions notify the person.
Comments in order; the author can edit or delete their own; others can report it. With none: "No comments yet. Be the first to share your thoughts."
Opens the report window (reason, one report each per person).

name: Learner Profile
elements: The public profile of a Learner. "Follow" or "Edit profile" (for the owner).
Counts; the lists open under the tabs.
Posts written by the Learner, and the lists. With none: "You have not posted anything. Share what you are learning." or "Could not load the list."
Shown to the owner when there is no post.

name: Write Post window
elements: Required, what the Learner wants to share. Background colours can be chosen for text-only posts.
Opens the attachment panel: from the computer (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, up to 5 MB each, up to 4 pictures) or by link; a video link from an allowed site such as YouTube. "Uploading…" then "Upload done".
Publishes the post (UC Write Post). Cancel asks "Cancel the post you are writing? Unposted content will be lost."

name: Post Composer
elements: Write what you want to share…
Main text: "What are you studying today? Ask, share or find a study partner…".
Optional, for example "How I raised my Writing by 0.5 band".
Add a picture from a link
Purple, Night, Sunset, Ocean, Forest, Pink, Aurora
Publishes. If it fails: "Could not post. Check the connection and try again." Leaving asks "Keep writing" or "Discard post".

name: Bookmarked Posts
elements: Saved posts. With none: "No saved posts. Tap the bookmark icon under a post to keep it to read later." An error shows "Could not load saved posts" and Retry.

name: Community Reports
elements: Heading "COMMUNITY MODERATION". A user without the right sees "You are not allowed to see this queue".
Open reports. While loading: "Loading reports…". With none: "No reports waiting."
Opens the post or comment that was reported.
Closes the report and keeps the content.
Hides the post or comment from learners; it is kept, not erased (DR-37).

name: Home
ucs: View Plans and Pricing, Browse Examiners
elements: Hero: mascot and "One step a day. Closer to your target band."
Welcome banner of the public site.
Learning benefits: four skills towards the IELTS goal
Section that introduces the four skills Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
Shows the plans (Premium) and the point cards, and how to enter an activation key. A message appears when the current plan cannot be loaded. The button opens the Activate Key window.

A form with full name and phone number, button "Send request". It checks the fields and shows "Consultation request sent! An adviser will contact you within 24 hours.", but the request is not sent anywhere yet (screen only).

name: Activate Key window
note: The window opens over the Home page, the plan page and the overview.
elements: Enter the full code you were given, with the prefix IP- if there is one. You do not pay here.
Explanation under the title "Activate plan / Top up key".
Required. Example: IP-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. A Guest sees "Sign in to activate a plan or top up points" and a Sign In button instead of the field.
Sends the code (UC Activate Key). Messages: key unknown, used, revoked or expired; e-mail not verified; "The result could not be confirmed. Keep the code and try again when the connection is stable."
Closes the window. After success the window shows "Activation successful" with the points or days granted, and a Done button.

name: Examiner Directory
elements: Learn with the most dedicated IELTS experts
Experts, Highest band, Certificates, Taking work
Filter by skill. A switch limits the list to Examiners who are taking work now.
Highest band, Most experienced, Name A-Z.

One card for each Examiner: name, expertise, graded essays, response time and a Taking work badge. "View profile" opens Examiner Detail. With no match: "No suitable expert found" and a Clear filter button.
Four steps to work with an expert
Explains the process: take the free placement test, choose an expert, send the Writing essay, read the review.

name: Examiner Detail
ucs: Browse Examiners, Request Examiner Review of Essay
elements: Name, photo and short introduction of the Examiner.
Degrees and certificates, areas of teaching, and the "verified" mark.
Four-criterion diagnosis (TR, CC, LR, GRA), inline error tags, band-up rewrites, and automatic update of the knowledge tree and the review basket. A sample feedback sheet is shown.
Starts the request for a review by this Examiner (UC Request Examiner Review of Essay). A Guest is sent to Sign In.

name: Home tab
elements: The published vocabulary topics. While loading: "Loading topics…". With none: "No vocabulary topics yet. Topics appear after they are published." On error: "Could not load vocabulary topics. Check the connection to the server and try again." and a Retry button.

name: Overview
elements: Overview / Detailed data / My achievements / My profile
Switches between the pages of the overview. Detailed data and achievements have their own rows below.
Shows the progress of the chosen course and the start, current and target band.
Course progress, the study streak with the record, and the time learned this week.
Skills of the course: the band of each skill and which one to improve first. With none graded: "No skill has been graded in this course yet."
Visible while a retake is left. Shows the retakes available.

name: Detailed Statistics
elements: Let us look at your detailed data again!
Heading: every learning step is recorded.
Legend and filter of the band chart.
Chart and table of the band of each eligible attempt: date, source and version, with the change from the earlier one. A grade that is being regraded is marked.
Progress by level over the words of IELTSPath.

name: Achievements
note: The mobile screen is called Learning progress and shows the same blocks in one column.
elements: Heading. Text: collect experience, keep the rhythm, unlock new milestones.
Level and experience points, hearts left, and the study streak.
Badges earned and still to earn.
Goes back to the learning path.

name: Profile and Security
ucs: Edit Profile, Change Password, Set Learning Goal
elements: Avatar - click or drop to change
Change or remove the picture. A failed upload shows "Upload failed".
Edit mode saves with "Saved successfully!". An invalid phone number shows "The phone number is not in the Vietnam format (for example 0912345678 or +84912345678)."
Used to count the study day and the streak.
Shows "E-mail not verified yet" and a button to send the verification e-mail again; a failure shows "Could not send the verification e-mail. Try again in a few minutes."
Decides who can see the profile and the learning activity.
A strength meter shows Very weak, Weak, Medium or Strong.
Saves it and shows "Password changed successfully!".
Removes the Google sign-in when the account has a password; a Google-only account must first create a password after confirming with Google.

name: Notification Preferences
elements: You can turn each kind of notice on or off. All are on by default.
Post comments / Replies / Mentions / Reactions / New followers
Premium activated / Premium ending / Result ready / Words due for review
Account and learning notices for the learner.
Essay to grade / Due soon / Overdue / Grade ready
Notices that go to Examiners, in their own group.

name: Account / Profile tab
elements: Shows the user name and e-mail. A Guest sees "Sign in to sync the profile" with a Sign In button.
Choose the XP goal for each day.
Study reminder / Streak reminder / Background music
Help and clearing the cache; clearing asks for confirmation.
Closes the session on the phone (UC Sign Out).

name: Edit Profile
elements: Avatar (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB)
Square, clear pictures are best. "Remove current picture" removes it.
Shown but cannot be changed here.
Band the learner believes they have.
Default Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; counts the study day and the streak.
Lets other learners see the community profile.

name: Change Password
note: The hint says at least 6 characters, but the server requires at least 8 and refuses weak passwords.
elements: Required: confirms who is changing it.

name: Notifications
elements: Notices are grouped by time. With none: "No notifications yet. When someone likes, comments or follows you, you will see it here."
Tapping a notice opens the post or the screen it is about. An error shows "Could not load notifications" and a Retry button.

name: Course List
note: The mobile Courses tab shows the same cards in one column and has no placement button.
elements: Offers the free placement test to find the current band. The button "Take placement test" opens Placement Test. When a retake is left it shows "Retake placement test" and the number of retakes.
All, Suggested for you, Studying, Completed, Ready for final
Filters the courses. With none: "No course in this group."
One card for each band course: band, free or paid, progress and "Last visit" time.
Small, optional tasks such as the review basket. "It is only a suggestion. Skipping it does not affect your path."

name: Placement Test
ucs: Start Placement Test, Take Placement Test, Record Placement Speaking
elements: Before the test: the levels and how many tries are left. A Learner with a test in progress sees "You have a test in progress. Saved answers are kept when you continue." and the buttons Continue and Check again.
Parts of the test. Quick jump to a part and question, Previous and Next question.
The passage or audio on the left and the questions on the right. Answers are saved while the Learner works; the study time recorder runs while the tab is active.
Saves the part. After the last part the system grades the test ("Grading your test") and opens the result.
Available when the Learner cannot record.

name: Topic List
elements: Study the skills in parallel or one by one, as you like.
Chooses the skill. Each skill shows the number of lessons.
The topics of the course in order, with progress. Opens Topic.
Opens when every topic is done. Messages: "The final test is not open. Finish every topic in the earlier course." or "There is no final test for this course yet." A passed test shows "Passed".

name: Knowledge Tree
elements: Study order and the level of mastery of each knowledge point.
Nodes are knowledge points, coloured by mastery. A node with a blocking review is marked. A node taught in free lessons is marked "Free".
Opens on a click: what it builds on, what it opens, where it is taught, and a button to take the blocking review.
List of common errors of the course.

name: Topic
ucs: Study a Lesson, Unlock Course Skill with Points
elements: Heading with the number of lessons and the estimated minutes.
Lessons in order. A status says Completed, In progress, "Review needed", "Optional review", "Reach the Practice part", or "Free trial". A locked lesson shows "Unlock".
Unlock the skill to take the topic test.
Shown when the skill is not unlocked.
States: "Passed"; "No test for this stage yet"; "Practise more before the test: <knowledge points>"; "The test is not open. Finish the lessons, more practice and the review if any."

name: Lesson
ucs: Study a Lesson, Answer Lesson Exercises, Write Essay in a Lesson
note: On the mobile app the lesson is studied in the Lesson Session screen.
elements: The content of the lesson, its words and its exercises.
Reading passages and exercises in blocks, lesson slides, "Lesson Summary" and documents.
Shown when a review is waiting: "You need to strengthen <knowledge point> before going on. The review has a short theory summary and a few questions." Button "Take review".
Starts the exercises. A lesson without exercises shows "Press Complete lesson to record your progress".
Opens the practice of the lesson once it is available.
Shows that study time is being recorded, or "Could not record study time. You can still go on."

name: Lesson Session
ucs: Study a Lesson, Answer Lesson Exercises
elements: Progress through the blocks of the lesson.
Text, video, slide or an exercise question. One block at a time.
Answer choices of an exercise question.
Grades the answer. A wrong answer costs one heart and shows the hint.
Goes to the next block; the last one finishes the lesson.

name: No Hearts window
elements: You have run out of hearts.
Title of the window. Explains that one heart comes back every 5 hours.
Time until the next heart; price of a full refill (5 points)
Shows when the next heart comes back and what a refill costs.
Pays 5 points and fills the hearts (UC Refill Hearts with Points). Not enough points shows a message.

name: Practice Set
elements: The set that goes with the lesson; "Audio" and "Transcript" when the set has listening.
Passage and questions. An essay question follows the Writing grading flow.
Grades the set. A set cleared at 70% shows "Passed".

Shows the score, the answers and explanations under each question, "Level up! Hearts refilled", "+XP", hearts lost, and "Daily XP cap reached: the excess is not counted, tomorrow it counts again". A set whose answers were shown before does not count.

name: Topic Test
ucs: Take Topic Test, Take Course Final Test
elements: Do the parts one by one; answers are saved at once. No time limit.
Parts of the test with the number of answered questions.
Passage or audio with transcript, and the questions. A message shows "Saving…", "Saved" or "Could not save; will try again when you submit".
Sends the test (UC Take Topic Test) and opens the result.

name: Topic Test Result
elements: Shown while the test is graded.
Result of the test. The first attempt counts for the course process score.
Each question with the answer and the explanation.
Returns to the course. "View course list" goes to the list.

name: Review
note: The mobile app has the same steps in a single column.
elements: Opens after the theory is confirmed: "Confirm that you read the theory to go to practice". Audio and transcript for listening questions.
Grades the review. Result: "Passed"; errors to fix; XP; hearts lost; "Keep studying" or "Open review basket".
After the second failed try: a short check of the knowledge this skill builds on. "Do at least one to be able to skip."

name: Prerequisite Check
elements: A short test of the knowledge point this skill builds on.
Questions with audio and transcript for listening.
Grades the check and shows the answers and explanations.
Returns to the review. If the check is closed: "This check is no longer open. You can go back to the review to see the next step."

name: Review Basket
elements: All skills that need review, in groups.
Required, Needs priority, Should strengthen, Due for review
Groups. Empty messages: "No required review. You are on track.", "Nothing else needs strengthening.", "Nothing is due."
Each card shows the knowledge point, why it is in the basket and a button "Take review".
Opens the next review. "No new question set yet" appears when none is ready.
Returns to the learning path. An empty basket shows "The review basket is empty".

name: Practice Test Catalog
elements: Chooses the skill of the tests.
Filter by status of the learner. A select limits the list to a question type.
One card for each test with its name and a Premium badge ("Premium needed") on tests that need a plan.

Opens when a test is chosen: information about the part and the choice of the look: "Practice look" with highlight and notes, or "Real exam look" like the IELTS computer test. A test already done offers "View result" or "Redo".

name: Reading Practice
elements: Timer, test name and the button Exit
Header of the test; "Exit" leaves the attempt.
The text of the passage. The divider can be dragged to change the width of the two sides. Tools on a selected text: Highlight, Note, Look up word.
The questions of the part, grouped; a bookmark marks a question to return to.
Question navigation with answered and bookmarked questions.
Asks "Submit?" with Continue and Submit. A timed test submits by itself at the end.

name: Listening Practice
elements: Timer, test name and the button Exit
Audio player of the section. "This section has no recording" appears when none exists.

name: Reading / Listening Result
elements: Score of the attempt in practice or full-test mode.

name: Answer Review
elements: The attempt, rebuilt as it was taken
If it cannot be rebuilt: "Could not rebuild the attempt."
Each question shows the answer given, the correct answer and the explanation.

name: Reading History
elements: The Reading tests the learner has submitted.
Submitted attempts. "View result" opens the result; "Show more" loads more. With none: "You have not submitted a Reading test yet" and the button "Choose a Reading test".

name: Writing Workspace
ucs: Write Essay for Grading, Write Essay in a Lesson
elements: Time left (real exam look) or time written (practice look) and Exit
Header. When time is up: "Time is up. The essay is locked."
The question and any chart or picture. The divider can be dragged.
The writing box with a word count. The button "Sample essay" shows a model answer in practice mode.
Submits the essay for AI grading (UC Write Essay for Grading). Messages: not enough points, daily limit, grading unavailable.

name: Writing Result
elements: Band, TR / TA, CC, LR, GRA
The band and the four criteria, graded by AI on a 0-9 scale by the IELTS band descriptors.
For each criterion: what was done well, what to improve, the evidence quoted from the essay and the description of the band.
Errors are marked in the text; a click shows the explanation. "View corrected essay" shows the correction.
Time, number of paragraphs, words per sentence, linking words used, most repeated words.
Starts a revision (UC Rewrite Essay). Available for lesson essays, up to three times.

name: Grading Job
elements: Shows where a review by an Examiner stands: waiting, claimed, graded, late.
This grading job was not found in your list.
Shown for a job that does not belong to the Learner.
Opens the result once the Examiner has graded.
Back to the list of essays graded by teachers

name: Examiner Reviews
ucs: Request Examiner Review of Essay, Track Grading Job
elements: Page also used for the history of submissions, with the tab "Essays graded by teachers".
In courses / 4-skill practice / By knowledge point / Graded by teachers
Reviews the Learner asked for. With none: "You have not submitted any <skill> yet".

name: Speaking Workspace
elements: Speaking, part and question number, and Exit
Header. When the time of a part ends: "The time of this part is up. Your recording is kept, go to the next step."
The question of the part, shown or played.
Button to start and stop recording, a timer and a level meter. The recording can be played back before moving on.
Goes to the next question; "This part has no question" appears for an empty part.

name: Speaking Review
elements: Listen to each answer again. Record again any answer you are not happy with before submitting.
One row for each question with a play button and a "Record again" button. "Answered" marks a done question.
I agree to send my voice recording to the speech recognition service and the AI model for grading
Consent in the confirm window that opens before grading; the grade button stays closed until it is ticked (DR-29).
Uploads and submits (UC Submit Speaking for Grading). Refusals: grading off, no consent, daily limit, not enough points, another submission waiting.

name: Speaking Result
elements: The band and the four criteria on a 0-9 scale. "Band capped" shows when a rule lowered the band.
What keeps you at this band
The weakest criterion, what to do next, the focus of improvement and a practice plan.
Good points and points to improve for each part, with quotes from the answer; words to practise pronunciation.
Transcript and measures from the voice
The transcript and measures taken from the voice; errors to fix with the rule and an exercise.
The AI score is for reference only.
Footer note. States when a result is missing: "Result not received", "The grading system has an error", "Submission stopped".

name: Submission History
elements: All the work the Learner has submitted.
In courses / 4-skill practice / By knowledge point / Graded by teachers
Rows open the result. With none: "You have not submitted any <skill> yet. Tests you take in 4-skill practice will appear here."

name: Content Author Home
elements: Content that exists and the work for R&D.
Coverage by skill and by CEFR level; depth of questions. Message when empty: "Nothing to handle yet".
Questions with a wrong difficulty, knowledge points with only one question, and points with no skill or no question. "View all" opens the full list.

name: Courses
elements: Manage courses by band, organise topics and open the lessons of each topic.
Opens the form to create a course.
Courses with a "Free" badge, and the topics of each. "Add topic" creates a topic; Edit course opens the form. With none: "No course yet".
Code, name, band, cover picture, banner, description, status (in use), "Free course for everyone" (no unlock price), skill unlock price in points.

name: Question Bank
elements: Questions shared by lessons, practice and tests.
Type, Skill, Purpose, FREE / PREMIUM, Status
Questions. "View detail" opens Question Detail. Deleting asks "Delete the question?"; it is archived, not erased.

name: Question Detail
elements: Versions of the question. "Add version" saves a new draft; "Version N saved as draft".
Versions with Publish and Archive. A published version is not edited (DR-13).
Question text, options, answer, explanation and hint; a picture can be chosen, replaced or removed (the original stays in storage).

name: Test Packages
elements: Create packages, write their versions and publish when ready.
Filters; search by code or title. Practice tests live in the Practice library, placement tests in the placement test store.
No., Code and title, Type, Access, Status
Packages. With none: "No package matches. Change the filter or create a package."

name: Package Editor
elements: A package without a version asks to create a draft. A published version is read-only: "Choose or create a draft to edit".
Chooses the version to view or edit.
Sections of the version. "Add section" opens the form: section title, part number (unique), time in minutes (more than 0), skill, instructions.
Shows the package as a Learner sees it.
Runs the checks and publishes the version, or schedules it (UC Manage Test Packages).

name: Placement Tests
elements: The packages used for the placement test, by level.
Level of the test; every placement package must have a level before it is published.
Placement packages. Created and published like other packages.

name: Practice Library
elements: Four-skill practice tests. Premium tests can only be taken by Learners with Premium.
Access filter; search by code or title.
Practice tests. "Hide from the library?" asks to confirm. "Edit info" changes the test.
Opens the form with package title and code, and the course, topic and lesson it belongs to.

name: Vocabulary Content
elements: Words and senses / Topics / Vocabulary sets
Words with their senses. Topics have a name, a cover picture and edit and delete; sets can be ordered and edited.

name: Grading Rubrics
elements: The criteria the AI uses to grade Writing and Speaking.
The active rubric of the task; "Create a draft from the one in use" copies it. When none: "No rubric in use for this task yet."
Drafts with "Edit draft". The editor has the source, the system prompt (up to 4,000 characters), the criteria and the band descriptions. "Rubric activated." confirms an activation.

name: Error Types
elements: Common mistakes, related knowledge and fix suggestions used to grade and diagnose.
Filters; search by code or name.
The catalogue. Each row has Edit, Details and Approve. The form holds the group, severity, related knowledge points (optional), a fix suggestion and the status.

name: Knowledge Graph
elements: Each cell is a knowledge point. A point below must be learned before the point right above it.
Skill, Course, Show inactive, Only with warnings
Lists points that are not connected. "The graph is fine: no isolated point, missing data or reverse link." when clean.
Opens the form. "Stop using the point?" hides it from Learners and from lesson writing; it can be switched on again.

name: Code Settings
elements: The structure of the generated codes.
Auto-generated code set / Allow editing the code

elements: The drafts that the AI model made for the Content Author.

Drafts. The list reloads every 5 seconds while a request waits or is being generated. With none: "No suitable draft."

Reference essay, Examiner band, AI band, Difference

Essay, Band graded, Graded at, Status, Action

elements: The essay and the task, with a button to enlarge a chart.
